limitations: This measurement covers all allocations of one prepared operation, not the eventual complete model graph high-watermark.

The private context remained alive during the before/after query so context overhead cancels; final module/context destruction is guaranteed by last-owner RAII but was not measured with an external NVML sampler here.
The context is intentionally thread-affine; a production daemon must route CUDA calls through one dedicated executor thread.
conclusion: Prepared CUDA graph objects are independently owned and release their complete observed driver allocation immediately on drop. This removes the self-referential-lifetime blocker for an embeddable executor, while full-graph unload and external NVML evidence remain promotion gates.
